articles.title: JPMorgan upgrades EMEA Metals & Mining stocks, names top picks into Q3 results
articles.summary: Investing.com -- JPMorgan upgraded Glencore, Kumba Iron Ore and Anglo American ahead of third-quarter results, naming Glencore, Antofagasta and gold miners as its highest-conviction picks for the fourth quarter and 2027.
